Switch FHEW ciphertexts to a CKKS ciphertext

Source: R/scheme-switching.R
eval_fhew_to_ckks_setup.Rd

Packs the messages of a list of FHEW (LWE) ciphertexts into the slots of one CKKS ciphertext (CKKS with real data and Feature$SCHEMESWITCH).

Usage

eval_fhew_to_ckks_setup(cc, cc_lwe, num_slots_ckks = 0L, log_q = 25L)

eval_fhew_to_ckks_key_gen(
  cc,
  key_pair,
  lwesk,
  num_slots = 0L,
  num_ctxts = 0L,
  dim1 = 0L,
  l = 0L
)

eval_fhew_to_ckks(
  cc,
  lwe_ciphertexts,
  num_ctxts = 0L,
  num_slots = 0L,
  p = 4L,
  pmin = 0,
  pmax = 2,
  dim1 = 0L
)

Arguments

cc

A CKKS CryptoContext.

cc_lwe

The BinFHEContext the ciphertexts come from.

num_slots_ckks, num_slots

Integer; number of CKKS slots, 0L (default) for the library's choice.

log_q

Integer; bits of the FHEW ciphertext modulus. Default 25L.

key_pair

The KeyPair of the CKKS context.

lwesk

The LWEPrivateKey of the FHEW context.

num_ctxts

Integer; number of ciphertexts to switch, 0L (default) for all.

dim1

Integer; baby-step dimension of the linear transform, 0L (default) for the library's choice.

l

Integer; level of the linear transform (the C++ argument L). Default 0L.

lwe_ciphertexts

A list of LWECiphertext objects.

p

Integer; plaintext modulus of the FHEW ciphertexts. Default 4L.

pmin, pmax

Numeric; the range of the messages. Defaults 0 and 2.

Value

eval_fhew_to_ckks(): a Ciphertext. The others: cc, invisibly.

Details

eval_fhew_to_ckks_setup() records the FHEW context cc_lwe in the CKKS context, and eval_fhew_to_ckks_key_gen() generates the keys of the switch.

The messages are taken modulo p; pmin and pmax give the range they lie in, which sets the interval of the Chebyshev approximation the switch evaluates. The defaults are for bits.

See also

eval_ckks_to_fhew()
